title: Co-area formula and level-set structure on one C¹ chart (Simon Ch. 2, 6.3, 6.4 and 6.6 for the submanifold ψ(V))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Let ψ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P be C¹, V ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} open with ψ injective on V and Dψ(y) injective for y ∈ V, F : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ C¹, and Y ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} Borel with closure(Y) compact and contained in V. Let G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P satisfy, for every y ∈ Y, G(ψ(y)) ∈ Dψ(y)(ℝ^{n+1}) and ⟨G(ψ(y)), Dψ(y)e⟩ = DF(y)e for all e ∈ ℝ^{n+1} (so G∘ψ is the gradient of F∘ψ⁻¹ along ψ(V)). Write Hᵏ = μHE[k]. Then: (i) for every Borel g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞], the function t ↦ ∫_{ψ(Y ∩ F⁻¹(t))} g dHⁿ is L¹-a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ ∫_{ψ(Y ∩ F⁻¹(t))} g dHⁿ dt = ∫_{ψ(Y)} |G| g dH^{n+1}; (ii) for L¹-a.e. t, the set S_t := ψ(Y ∩ F⁻¹(t)) is countably n-rectifiable, and for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ S_t we have G(x) ≠ 0 and, for the y ∈ Y with ψ(y) = x, S_t has approximate tangent space Dψ(y)(ℝ^{n+1}) ∩ G(x)^⊥ at x.
